cases.name: Lilie Kristine Walker
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Lilie is an exceptional young woman with many extraordinary gifts and talents. Her ability to brighten any room with her presence, and her warrior spirit that rose to every challenge, are things that we all should remember. She is brave and has the biggest, kindest heart. She is an artist, a gamer, and an avid reader. She enjoys social media and watching movies. Her absolute favorite thing to do is to spend time with those she loves. Her family was robbed of watching Lilie’s continued bloom into her own unique person. Lilie is her parents’ beautiful princess and always will be."
